verdict.rationale: Veriff has some ways to get data out: per-session details can be exported to PDF from the pricing-listed features, and decision data can be pulled as structured responses by polling GET /v1/sessions/{id}/decision or receiving webhooks. Nothing in the pack shows a bulk, account-wide export or a documented exit path. Missing for 10: bulk/full-account data export, export of media and biometric data, documented open export formats (e.g. CSV/JSON dumps), data portability or offboarding/deletion guidance, independent corroboration.
